scripts.sync-profile: mkdir -p static/css static/js static/data static/assets && cp profile.html static/profile.html && (cmp -s resume.json static/data/resume.json || cp resume.json static/data/resume.json) && cp css/styles.css static/css/styles.css && cp css/cinematic.css static/css/cinematic.css && cp css/enhancements.css static/css/enhancements.css && cp js/app.js static/js/app.js && cp js/profile-render.js static/js/profile-render.js && cp js/depth.js static/js/depth.js && cp js/enhancements.js static/js/enhancements.js && cp js/three-scene.js static/js/three-scene.js && cp js/profile-sfx.js static/js/profile-sfx.js && ([ -f js/naresh-ai.mjs ] && cp js/naresh-ai.mjs static/js/naresh-ai.mjs || true) && cp public/assets/profile.jpg static/assets/profile.jpg && cp public/assets/drivethrough.webp static/assets/drivethrough.webp && cp public/assets/profile-preview.png static/assets/profile-preview.png
